summary: S1 (eps 1-11) adapts the Spring and Summer arcs, ch 1-29, plus the standalone two-part side story 'Memories of Summer' (ch 30-31) pulled forward into ep 5; S2 (eps 12-22) adapts the Autumn arc (ch 32-63) and the first half of Winter (ch 64-75), ending mid-volume 9 with the reader resuming at ch 76. Hard pins: ep1=ch1-2 (fandom infobox + MAL), ep16 ends exactly at ch52 (MAL; father debuts ch53/ep17), ep20 ends ch68 (MAL), ep21 ends ch71 (MAL x2), ep22 ends ch75 (MAL x2, Lost in Anime, anime.stackexchange, chiebukuro '9巻の途中'). Fandom character 'manga_debut/anime_debut' pairs (Maron ch3/ep2, Shiroishi ch7/ep3, Komaba twins ch14/ep6, Shingo ch19/ep8, Misako ch28/ep11, Vice-Prez ch36/ep13, Ayame ch45/ep15, Kazumasa ch53/ep17) and the publisher's per-volume blurbs+TOCs (Kinokuniya 出版社内容情報) bound every other episode to a 2-5 chapter window; the exact boundaries inside those windows (eps 2/3, 6/7, 8-10, 13/14, 15, 17-19) are interpolations and are marked medium. Surprises: the S1 finale borrows an early-round autumn-tournament baseball game from the Autumn arc (chapter unidentified) so S2E1 re-enters the Autumn arc out of order; the two 'Heroes' Comeback' specials (66.5, 66.9) are not adapted. Existing anchor ep22->75 v9 is confirmed. NOTE: the session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) before this task, so all research was by direct fetch (fandom api.php, MAL threads, Lost in Anime, Kinokuniya, Yahoo!知恵袋, anime.stackexchange); RandomC/Namu/TV Tropes/Moegirl/Nicopedia/reddit/desuarchive were bot-walled.

anchors.note: Fandom episode infobox lists Chapter 1 + Chapter 2 (fandom Chapter 1/2 pages point back to Episode 1); MAL ep1 thread: 'this only covered two chapters from the manga'.

Club-joining + first ride. Fandom debuts: Maron ch3/ep2, Holstein Trio ch3/ep2, Nakajima ch3/ep2, Okawa ch4/ep2 -> episode starts at ch3 (high). End at 4 vs 5 is interpolated: MAL ep3 thread says ep3 'rushed through the chapters' (>=3 chapters) and Shiroishi debuts ch7/ep3, so ep3 = 5-7.

Golden Week ban'ei race + Pork Bowl. Pork Bowl manga debut ch7; Shiroishi (old-school teacher) debut ch7 / anime ep3; MAL ep4 poster re-read 'Chapter 8-10' after ep4 -> ep3 ends at 7. Start 5 interpolated (see ep2). Fandom's 'Pork Bowl anime debut = Episode 2' conflicts with ep3's title and is treated as an error/teaser.

Pizza-oven arc. MAL ep4 thread: 'I read the manga again Chapter 8-10' + 'faithful adaptation of the corresponding chapters'; fandom Chapter 10 summary = Inada bacon-for-pizza scene (ch10 = Spring 10, last Spring chapter; Summer starts ch11 per Kinokuniya v2 TOC).

Standalone side story 'Memories of Summer' (夏の思い出 前編/後編 = ch30-31 per Kinokuniya v4 TOC and Wikipedia volume list): the 'Area 51' combine-harvester night escape (fandom Arcs page). MAL ep5 thread: 'one of the few standalone chapters... placed this chapter so early'; Tamako's harvester reveal was changed (MAL + Lost in Anime comment) -> mixed type stands.

Summer 1 (ch11) opens the Mikage-farm job (Kinokuniya v2: 'この巻で「夏の巻」に入ります...アキの実家にバイトで'); Komaba twins/mother debut ch14/ep6 and Komaba's father 'ch15 (flashback) / ep6 (mentioned)' -> episode reaches ch15. Exact end (14 vs 15) interpolated.
Giga Farm visit + Aki's worries. Bounded: after ch15 (ep6) and before Shingo's debut ch19 (ep8); ja.wikipedia story order puts Shingo's visit right after Giga Farm. Interpolated within 16-18.

Shingo debuts ch19/ep8 (fandom); MAL ep8 thread: 'adapt 4 of my favourite chapters into a single rushed episode' -> 19-22 (job's last day, milk mistake, pay). Kinokuniya v3 blurb places the return to the dorm within v3 (18-26).
Back from break / Pork Bowl underweight. Interpolated between ep8 (ends 22) and ep10 (Pork Bowl decision <=26 per Kinokuniya v3 blurb, meat returns ch27+ per v4 blurb).
Shipping + decision to buy the meat (v3: '豚丼が、ついに肉になってしまうことに…八軒がくだした驚きの決断') and the meat's return (v4 blurb: '豚丼が肉になって帰ってきた', ch27 = Summer 17); Misako (mother) debuts ch28/ep11 so ep10 ends <=27.

Bacon fad + mother's phone call (Misako debut ch28/ep11) through Summer 19 (ch29): Lost in Anime commenter 'the first season of the anime ended at the last chapter of the summer arc', with the rebuttal that it 'entered a bit into the autumn arc' (the stadium baseball game = autumn 秋季大会 material, see annotation); 知恵袋: ep11 is '原作では4巻の途中'. Ch30-31 already used in ep5.
Autumn 1-4 (VP appointment, Aki/Komaba scene). Bounded by the puppy Vice-Prez debut ch36 / ep13 (fandom) and ja.wikipedia '副ぶちょー: 第5巻で登場' (v5 = ch36-44); no source states the exact end.
Puppy adoption/vaccines/training. Start 36 = Vice-Prez debut (fandom ch36/ep13; Kinokuniya v5 'この巻で、エゾノーの新しい仲間が登場'). End interpolated (36-44 is split across eps 13-14).
Jump-class failure, riding-club visit, first jump with Maron: Kinokuniya v5 blurb '八軒がついに障害飛越に挑戦' (v5 ends ch44); Ayame debuts ch45/ep15 so ep14 ends <=44. Start interpolated.
Debut competition + Ayame (ch45 debut, fandom; Kinokuniya v6 '八軒のデビュー戦'). End interpolated: ep16 (festival prep, date, collapse) must cover ~49-52 since it ends exactly at 52.

MAL S2E5 thread: 'Exactly at the end of chapter 52. You can start at 53'; Kazumasa (father) debuts ch53 / ep17 (fandom); Kinokuniya v7 blurb: the collapse is at '6巻の最後' (v6 = 45-53). Start interpolated.
Hospital/father (ch53 = Kazumasa debut) + festival aftermath. End interpolated: ep18 adapts 5 chapters (MAL) and Komaba's tournament sits in v7 (54-61).
秋季大会 baseball final. MAL S2E7 thread: 'They adapted 5 chapters in ONE episode'; Kinokuniya v7 (54-61) blurb: '甲子園に一縷の望みを掛け、戦いつづける駒場'. Exact window interpolated (57-61 = end of v7).

Komaba quits; farm bankruptcy; 'Hachiken Howls'. Lost in Anime commenter: 'the autumn arc has ended in chapter #63 with the folks finding out that Komaba farm went bankrupt' (ch63 = Autumn 32 per Kinokuniya v8 TOC); v8 blurb (62-70) covers 'the moment a dream shatters' and the Aki near-confession. Could run into ch64 (Winter 1).
MAL S2E9 thread: 'This episode ended at chapter 68 in the manga' (single precise source); consistent with ep21 = 69-71 and ep22 = 72-75.

MAL S2E10 thread: 'start with chapter 72'; MAL S2E11 thread: 'Last episode deals with chapters 72-75'. Lost in Anime commenter estimated 'ended around chapter #72-73 (more or less I think)' - vaguer, not adopted. Ch71 = Winter 8 (Kinokuniya v9 TOC). MAL poster notes many scenes skipped.

Confirms existing anchor. MAL S2E11: 'Chapter 76, which begins with Vice-Prez and snow' and 'Last episode deals with chapters 72-75'; Lost in Anime: 'start from chapter #76'; anime.stackexchange: S2 ends at ch75 (mother's visit); 知恵袋: '9巻の途中'. Kinokuniya v9 blurb: Sapporo homecoming.

continue_points.note: Ep 5 is the out-of-order side story ch 30-31; the main story resumes at Summer 1 (ch 11) in ep 6.
Ch 30-31 were already adapted in ep 5; S2 opens the Autumn arc at ch 32 (Autumn 1). The autumn baseball material grafted into ep 11 is re-covered in S2.
end+1 (MAL/LiA: 'start from chapter 76'). Unadapted specials 66.5 and 66.9 ('Heroes' Comeback' flashback) are worth reading too (LiA commenter).

annotations.note: 'Memories of Summer' two-parter is published after Summer 19 (ch29) and set at the end of summer; the anime moved it to ep 5, before the summer-vacation arc, and changed Tamako's combine-harvester reveal (MAL/LiA) - hence mixed type.

S1 finale adds an early-round 秋季大会 baseball game that belongs to the Autumn arc (LiA commenter: the last S1 episode 'entered a bit for the autumn arc, resulting in some kind of change in the original order'); ja.wikipedia's story order places the tournament after the VP appointment (Autumn 1).
S2E1 re-enters the Autumn arc from ch32 but skips/reorders what ep 11 borrowed (LiA S2E1 comment: 'adapting the manga chapters very quickly and not necessarily in order'; 知恵袋: '原作の順番を多少前後').
Four chapters compressed into one episode (MAL ep8 thread).
Five chapters compressed into one episode (MAL S2E7 thread).

Two special chapters ('Heroes' Comeback' flashback about Hachi/Toku/Pekushi - fandom Arcs page; fandom lists their debut as 'Chapter 66') are not adapted; LiA commenter recommends reading them alongside the ch76 pickup.

structure.notes: Two TV seasons only: Gin no Saji (AniList/MAL 16918, 11 eps, 2013-07-11..09-19 JST) and Gin no Saji 2 (19363, 11 eps, 2014-01-09..03-27); cumulative numbering 1-22 matches our rows. No OVA/special/recap exists (Wikipedia, MAL, fandom, animefillerlist all list 22 episodes; the 2014 live-action film is unrelated to the anime order). Manga: 131 chapters / 15 volumes; volume boundaries in the context file are confirmed by the Kinokuniya per-volume TOCs (v1 1-8 Spring 1-8; v2 9-17; v3 18-26; v4 27-35 incl. 夏の思い出 前編/後編 = ch30-31 and Autumn 1-4 = ch32-35; v5 36-44; v6 45-53; v7 54-61; v8 62-70 with Autumn 32 = ch63 and Winter 1 = ch64; v9 71-79). The anime covers ch1-75 (ends mid-v9); a continuation would start at ch76 / Winter 13.

flags_for_sean: Session WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) when this task started; everything here comes from direct fetches. Fandom 'Pork Bowl' page says anime debut Episode 2 while the manga debut is ch7 and ep3 is titled 'Hachiken Meets Pork Bowl'; treated as a fandom error (or a teaser scene), not as evidence that ep2 reaches ch7.
Ep 11's grafted autumn baseball game: LiA commenter confirms S1's finale dipped into the Autumn arc, but no source names the chapter; recorded as '32-35 (partial)'.

Ep 21 end: MAL says 71 (twice, from different posters); a Lost in Anime commenter said '~72-73 (more or less I think)'. Adopted 71 (high) because the MAL statements are precise and mutually consistent with ep22 = 72-75.
